answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on qubit 0, CNOT 0 to 1, CNOT 1 to 2, and a measurement of all 3 qubits. The job ID is 01a15f17-deef-73f8-a7e9-30651f83a2fc, and the job completed with no errors. The counts were {"000": 200}. The mock backend does not simulate the circuit. It returned all zeros, so these counts do not show the real GHZ pattern of about half 000 and half 111. The transpiled circuit had 5 r gates, 2 cz gates, 4 move gates, and 3 measurements. The 4 move gates are there because Sirius uses a resonator to connect qubits. The mock job cost 0 credits. The QASM file is /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-48/ghz3.qasm.
